notes.title: Follow our Kickstarter Page!
notes.content:
ERROR!UNKNOWN has sent you a Kickstarter link…

[previewyoutube=KIjgwVPpbYg;full][/previewyoutube]
Open it?

Hi hi! I'm excited to announce that my Kickstarter Prelaunch Page for Killer Chat! Expanded Edition is up :D Follow it to get notified when the game launches!

After asking too many murder-related questions online (for your book), you get invited to a... serial killer chatroom?!

As you might know, Killer Chat! is a dark satirical dating sim where you date serial killers! ;) My official launch date for the Kickstarter is: 

4th of June, 2025!

I've also got a bunch of rewards prepared! ❤️ From a game key to making your own random server event and dressing up the serial losers, I can't wait to share it with you :)

https://i.imgur.com/SqgnNZw.png

Help me spread the rot! 

Getting funded is far from a guarantee (and Kickstarter as a process is quite scary, haha), so I'd really appreciate your help in making the Kickstarter succeed, whether that's pledging or talking about it 🫶 You can join my Discord to get notified when I push out promo everywhere :D

If you're a game dev or a journalist and would like to help out, cross-promote, etc, I'd love to hear it!! Feel free to reach out by email at rosesrotofficial@gmail.com!

Thank you again and I can't wait to get this show on the road!

notes.title: The Dev Plays Killer Chat! (Broadcasting Now)
notes.content:
Hi friends! As you might've realised by now, I'm doing a Killer Chat! livestream of our demo. This is a pre-recorded stream (and looped), because finagling OBS has been a real pain, but I hope you enjoy my gameplay and commentary nonetheless!

The broadcast is live now!


Thank you as always for all your support for KC! Don't forget to like and subscribe... err, I mean wishlist the Expanded Edition :)

Love,
rosesrot

notes.title: OUR STEAM DEMO IS NOW LIVE ‼️
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/dNGkDKn.png

Month 1 of Killer Chat! is now on Steam to download as a demo! 

Help us out, chat! 📢 
We are building our presence on steam to help make KC bigger and better! Here are some ways you can give us hand!

Play the demo! 🔪 
Playing demos helps game visibility on Steam. If you want to help us out, playing the demo helps us convert more rotterlings to the KC! community! More rotterlings = more investment in future Killer Chat content! 😈

To reward your help we’ve made a couple of small additions exclusive to the demo! 
- Bonus dialogue 💭 
- Easter eggs! ❤️
- A couple small surprises! 🪽 

Wishlist Killer Chat! Expanded Edition 🩸 
Expanded Edition is the new name for Definitive Edition! This game version will be much bigger, better and bloodier, and kickstarted in the Summer. Wishlisting makes it more visible to newcomers by telling steam that people love the game! If you haven’t wishlisted it already, you can do it here.

Spread the word! 
Liking and reposting our social media posts is another great way to help out. You guys are doing an amazing job at spreading the word, so keep up the good work!
